**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 13 already delivers our preferred licence position:

- **Affiliates and contractors covered** — §13.1 grants the hosted-Services right to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf," with Authorized Users permitted; §13.2 extends paid-up licences to Customer and its Affiliates and allows contractors to support the material.
- **Paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable** — §13.2 is expressly "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid," including broad modify/derivative-works rights, and §14.3 confirms it flows through to Vendor Technology embedded in Deliverables.
- **Not revocable at will** — §13.3 bars revocation or suspension except for a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity.
- **Transferable to successors** — §13.3 read with §24.1 permits transfer to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent; §24.4 blocks Vendor from suspending or repricing on our change of control.

The only restrictions (§13.4) are standard anti-reverse-engineering/security provisions carved back for legally protected activities and our own Customer Data and output, so they do not narrow the grant below the playbook floor.
